name: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC
exchange: London Stock Exchange (XLON) — GDRs; also Astana International Exchange (AIX)
blurb: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC is the world's largest uranium producer, headquartered in Astana, Kazakhstan. The company accounts for roughly 40% of global primary uranium output, selling uranium concentrates and conversion products to nuclear power operators across Asia, Europe, and North America. Majority-owned by Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund Samruk-Kazyna, Kazatomprom extracts uranium almost exclusively via low-cost in-situ recovery (ISR) across Kazakhstan's southern uranium deposits. Its global depositary receipts (GDRs) trade on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker KAP.
recent: As of May 14, 2026, KAP GDRs were quoted at approximately $70.10, off 3.04% on the day per Morningstar. The company filed a regulatory announcement on the London Stock Exchange disclosing its 1H2025 financial results and its 2026 production strategy.
